target.statement: DBM Fbefore AUROC on Bank Marketing (mean over 20 seeds) = 0.713 ± 0.009
target.dataset: UCI Bank Marketing (id=222), binarized to D=69 visible bits

compute.basis: Paper reports DBM training at ~176 s per seed on CPU (Table 8), so 20 seeds ≈ 60 min of training alone; but no code is released, so the DBM (PCD pretraining + mean-field fine-tuning, early stopping, binarization pipeline) must be reimplemented from the text, and the 20-seed protocol plus baselines and fusion add substantial debugging/command time; GPU is slower per the paper's own Metal measurement.

blockers: No code or repository linked anywhere in the paper
DBM training protocol (PCD, mean-field fine-tuning, early stopping, checkpointing) must be reimplemented from prose
Exact binarization/quantile-binning pipeline and 90/10 inlier split details must be inferred
20-seed protocol with paired t-tests required for the headline mean±SE
title: Revisiting Energy-based Tabular Anomaly Detection: Energy and Reconstruction are Complementary
